parameters.name: CipherSuite
parameters.description: The type of the cipher suite.

parameters.name: CustomCiphers
parameters.description: The specific custom cipher suites to add. This parameter is used only when **CipherSuite** is set to **99**.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name that you want to manage.

parameters.name: EnableTLSv3
parameters.description:
Specifies whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

- **true**: TLS 1.3 is supported.

- **false**: TLS 1.3 is not supported.

> This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
